clock_and_reset_waveform.CLK_I: Single rising-edge clock per WISHBONE interface. All output signals are registered at the rising edge of CLK_I; all input signals are stable before the rising edge of CLK_I.
clock_and_reset_waveform.RST_I: Active HIGH. Reset cycles MAY be extended for any length of time. RST_I MUST be asserted for at least one complete CLK_I cycle. On the rising CLK_I edge following the assertion of RST_I, MASTER outputs [STB_O] and [CYC_O] are negated; SLAVE self-starting state machines initialize.

reset_waveform_sequence: T-1: bus in operation; STB_O or CYC_O may be asserted.
T0 (RST_I asserted asynchronously): MASTER signals STB_O and CYC_O are still in their pre-reset state; no immediate change.
T1 (rising CLK_I after RST_I asserted): STB_O <= 0, CYC_O <= 0; SLAVE self-starting state machines initialize.
T2 .. Tn (RST_I held HIGH for n>=1 cycles): bus held in initialized state.
Tn+1 (rising CLK_I after RST_I negated): STB_O and CYC_O MAY be asserted to start a new transfer.

single_read_classic_standard_waveform.case: Single READ, standard handshake, no wait state (Figure 3-5)
sequence: Clock edge 0: MASTER drives ADR_O=A, TGA_O=valid, WE_O=0 (read), SEL_O=valid, CYC_O=1, TGC_O=valid, STB_O=1.
Clock edge 1: SLAVE asserts ACK_I=1, drives DAT_I=Data(A) and TGD_I=valid (or SLAVE inserts -WSS- wait state(s) before asserting ACK_I).
Clock edge 2: MASTER latches DAT_I and TGD_I; MASTER negates STB_O and CYC_O; SLAVE negates ACK_I in response to negated STB_O.

single_read_classic_pipelined_waveform.case: Single READ, pipelined, no wait state (Figure 3-6)
sequence: Clock edge 0: MASTER drives ADR_O=A, TGA_O=valid, WE_O=0, SEL_O=valid, CYC_O=1, TGC_O=valid, STB_O=1; STALL_I=0 (slave accepts).
Clock edge 1: SLAVE asserts ACK_I=1, drives DAT_I=Data(A); MASTER negates STB_O (no more requests in this cycle) and latches data.
Clock edge 2: MASTER negates CYC_O ending the cycle; SLAVE negates ACK_I.

single_write_classic_standard_waveform.case: Single WRITE, standard handshake, no wait state (Figure 3-7)
sequence: Clock edge 0: MASTER drives ADR_O=A, DAT_O=Data(A), TGA_O=valid, TGD_O=valid, WE_O=1, SEL_O=valid, CYC_O=1, TGC_O=valid, STB_O=1.
Clock edge 1: SLAVE prepares to latch DAT_O+TGD_O; SLAVE asserts ACK_I (or inserts -WSS- wait state(s) first).
Clock edge 2: SLAVE latches data; MASTER negates STB_O and CYC_O; SLAVE negates ACK_I in response.

block_read_classic_standard_waveform.case: BLOCK READ with 5 phases, MASTER and SLAVE both insert one wait state each (Figure 3-10)
sequence: Clock edge 0: MASTER drives ADR_O=A0, TGA_O=valid, WE_O=0, SEL_O=valid, CYC_O=1, TGC_O=valid; STB_O=1 (first phase).
Clock edge 1: SLAVE drives DAT_I=D0, asserts ACK_I; MASTER prepares to latch.
Clock edge 2: MASTER latches D0; MASTER negates STB_O (-WSM- master wait state).
Clock edge 3: MASTER drives ADR_O=A1, asserts STB_O for second phase.
Clock edge 4: SLAVE drives DAT_I=D1, asserts ACK_I.
Clock edge 5: MASTER latches D1; MASTER negates STB_O AND CYC_O ending the BLOCK; SLAVE negates ACK_I.
Throughout the BLOCK, CYC_O remains asserted (single CYC_O wrapping multiple STB_O phases).

block_read_pipelined_waveform.case: Pipelined BLOCK READ with STALL_I causing a request repeat (Figure 3-11)
sequence: Clock edge 0: MASTER drives ADR_O=A0, asserts CYC_O+TGC_O+STB_O; STALL_I=0.
Clock edge 1: SLAVE drives DAT_I=D0, asserts ACK_I; MASTER drives ADR_O=A1 (next request).
Clock edge 2: STALL_I=1 -> MASTER re-asserts the same request.
Clock edge 3: STALL_I=0 -> request accepted; MASTER drives next request or negates STB_O.
Clock edge 4: SLAVE drives DAT_I=D1, asserts ACK_I; MASTER latches; MASTER negates CYC_O upon receiving the last ACK_I.

block_write_classic_standard_waveform.case: BLOCK WRITE with 5 phases, MASTER and SLAVE both insert wait states (Figure 3-12)
sequence: Clock edge 0: MASTER drives ADR_O=A0, DAT_O=D0, WE_O=1, SEL_O=valid, CYC_O=1, TGC_O=valid, STB_O=1.
Clock edge 1: SLAVE asserts ACK_I.
Clock edge 2: MASTER monitors ACK_I, negates STB_O (-WSM-).
Clock edge 3: MASTER drives ADR_O=A1, DAT_O=D1, asserts STB_O for second phase.
Clock edge 4: SLAVE asserts ACK_I.
Clock edge 5: MASTER terminates the cycle by negating STB_O AND CYC_O.
READ phase — Clock edge 0: MASTER drives ADR_O=A, TGA_O=valid, WE_O=0, SEL_O=valid, CYC_O=1, TGC_O=valid, STB_O=1.
Setup edge 1: SLAVE drives DAT_I=Data(A), asserts ACK_I.
Clock edge 1: MASTER latches READ data; MASTER negates STB_O (-WSM-).
WRITE phase — Setup edge 2: SLAVE negates ACK_I; MASTER asserts WE_O=1 (any number of MASTER wait states permitted here).
Clock edge 2: MASTER drives DAT_O=Modified(Data(A)), TGD_O=valid, drives new SEL_O, asserts STB_O.
Setup edge 3: SLAVE asserts ACK_I and prepares to latch write data (SLAVE wait states may be inserted here).
Clock edge 3: SLAVE latches WRITE data; MASTER negates STB_O AND CYC_O; SLAVE negates ACK_I. The cycle is atomic from arbitration standpoint because CYC_O stays asserted throughout.

registered_feedback_classic_waveform.case: Registered Feedback Classic cycle (CTI_O=3'b000) — same as Wishbone Classic, single transfer (Figure 4-4)
sequence: Clock edge 0: MASTER drives ADR_O, asserts CYC_O+TGC_O+CTI_O=000+STB_O.
Clock edge 1..N: SLAVE prepares response (faster because it knows it is Classic — no early-burst preparation needed).
Last clock edge: SLAVE asserts ACK_I; MASTER latches data; MASTER negates STB_O+CYC_O.

registered_feedback_constant_address_bur.case: Constant Address Burst write (CTI_O=3'b001) — multiple writes to same ADR_O (FIFO-like) (Figure 4-8 / 4-9)
sequence: Clock edge 0: MASTER drives ADR_O=A (constant), DAT_O=D0, CYC_O=1, CTI_O=001, WE_O=1, SEL_O=valid, STB_O=1.
Clock edge 1: SLAVE asserts ACK_I (slave decoded and is ready to keep receiving).
Clock edge 2: MASTER drives DAT_O=D1, SLAVE keeps ACK_I asserted.
Clock edge 3: MASTER drives DAT_O=D2, MAY insert wait state by negating STB_O; SLAVE inserts wait by negating ACK_I.
Clock edge N (last beat): MASTER asserts CTI_O=3'b111 (End-of-Burst) together with the last STB_O; SLAVE recognizes End-of-Burst.
Clock edge N+1: MASTER negates STB_O AND CYC_O ending the burst; SLAVE negates ACK_I.

registered_feedback_incrementing_burst_w.case: Incrementing Burst (CTI_O=3'b010, BTE_O selects wrap size) — 4-beat WRAP4 (BTE=2'b01) 32-bit incrementing burst (Figure 4-10)
sequence: Clock edge 0: MASTER drives ADR_O=N+8 (start), CTI_O=010, BTE_O=01 (wrap4), CYC_O=1, STB_O=1, WE_O=0, SEL_O=valid; SLAVE captures burst type.
Clock edge 1: MASTER drives ADR_O=N+C (next); SLAVE asserts ACK_I and presents DAT_I=Data(N+8); MASTER latches.
Clock edge 2: MASTER drives ADR_O=N (wrapped); SLAVE asserts ACK_I and presents DAT_I=Data(N+C).
Clock edge 3: MASTER drives ADR_O=N+4; SLAVE asserts ACK_I and presents DAT_I=Data(N); MASTER prepares for last beat.
Clock edge 4: MASTER asserts CTI_O=3'b111 (End-of-Burst); SLAVE asserts ACK_I and presents DAT_I=Data(N+4).
Clock edge 5: MASTER negates STB_O AND CYC_O; SLAVE negates ACK_I.

tag_signals_waveform_summary.TGA_O_TGA_I: Aligned with ADR_O / ADR_I; qualified by STB_O / STB_I.
tag_signals_waveform_summary.TGD_O: Aligned with DAT_O; qualified by STB_O.
tag_signals_waveform_summary.TGD_I: Aligned with DAT_I; qualified by STB_I (Figure 3-1 illustration shows TAG TYPE arrays as VALID stripes overlapping STB_O assertion).
tag_signals_waveform_summary.TGC_O_TGC_I: Aligned with CYC_O / CYC_I; qualified by CYC_O / CYC_I (held valid through the entire cycle).

max_outstanding_rules.wishbone_classic_standard: Single outstanding (handshake protocol — no new STB_O until previous STB_O acknowledged).
max_outstanding_rules.wishbone_classic_pipelined: Multiple outstanding requests permitted; bounded by SLAVE pipeline depth, signaled by STALL_I.
max_outstanding_rules.wishbone_registered_feedback: One transfer per clock cycle within a burst (subject to MASTER/SLAVE wait states).

interconnect_combination_rules.shared_bus: Single arbiter selects one MASTER at a time; only the granted MASTER drives the bus signals; the other MASTERs' outputs are held inactive.
interconnect_combination_rules.crossbar_switch: Parallel channels — multiple Master->Slave paths can be active simultaneously, each with its own STB_O/ACK_I handshake; throughput aggregates.
interconnect_combination_rules.data_flow: Sequential cores forming a pipeline; each core has both SLAVE (input) and MASTER (output) interfaces; concurrency from pipeline parallelism.

evidence.quote: Notes: (1) Reset cycles can be extended for any length of time. (2) Self-starting state machines & counters reset themselves at the rising [CLK_I] edge following the assertion of [RST_I]. On MASTERs, [STB_O] and [CYC_O] are negated at the same time. (3) On MASTERs, [STB_O] and [CYC_O] may be asserted at the rising [CLK_I] edge following the negation of [RST_I].

Classic standard SINGLE READ cycle: CLK_I, ADR_O VALID, DAT_I VALID, DAT_O all-X, WE_O low, SEL_O VALID, STB_O high during read, ACK_I high during read, CYC_O high during read, TGA_O VALID, TGD_I VALID, TGD_O all-X, TGC_O VALID.
Classic pipelined SINGLE READ cycle: STB_O is asserted for a single cycle, STALL_I controls master throttling, ACK_I single pulse for the single beat.
Classic standard SINGLE WRITE cycle: ADR_O VALID, DAT_O VALID, WE_O high, SEL_O VALID, STB_O high during write, ACK_I high, CYC_O high, TGA_O VALID, TGD_O VALID, TGC_O VALID.
Standard BLOCK READ cycle with addresses A0, A1, data D0, D1; STB_O pulses high for two phases inside a single sustained CYC_O. MASTER inserts wait state -WSM- between phases.
Pipelined BLOCK READ cycle: STALL_I=1 during clock cycle 1 causes MASTER to repeat last request.
Standard BLOCK WRITE cycle with addresses A0, A1, data D0, D1; STB_O pulses inside sustained CYC_O; WE_O HIGH throughout.
RMW cycle: first half is a READ (WE_O=0); second half is a WRITE (WE_O=1); CYC_O remains asserted across both halves.
Classic Cycle (CTI_O=000): same waveform as Classic SINGLE READ — single-beat transfer with CYC_O+STB_O+CTI_O=000 +ACK_I.
CTI_O=001 throughout the burst; ADR_O held constant; data beats D0, D1, ...; End-of-Burst marker CTI_O=3'b111 on the last beat.
4-beat wrapped incrementing burst for a 32-bit data array (BTE_O=2'b01, CTI_O=3'b010): ADR_O=N+8 -> N+C -> N -> N+4; End-of-Burst CTI_O=3'b111 on the last beat.
